missingPath: No note is selected. Open one from the left pane.
notFound: This note was not found. It may have been renamed or deleted.
loadFailed: The note could not be opened because the server is not reachable. It will try again once connected.

saveErrors.offline: The server is not reachable. Your draft is kept in the browser and will be saved once connected.
saveErrors.disk-full: Could not save because the disk is full. Free some space, then click Try again.
saveErrors.locked: Could not save because the file is open or locked somewhere else. Close it there, then click Try again.
saveErrors.write-failed: Could not write the file. Your draft is kept; check the disk, then click Try again.
saveErrors.other: The note was not saved yet. Your draft is kept; click Try again.

banners.discardBody: The note goes back to exactly what was on disk when you opened it. What the draft holds will be lost.
banners.notUtf8: This note is not UTF-8, so it is read-only.
banners.control: This document tells the AI how to work with your vault. Edit it with care.
banners.template: This is a template. New notes made from it start with this content.
banners.kept_one: {{count}} version was set aside on reload.
banners.kept_other: {{count}} versions were set aside on reload.

source.shortcut: Turn source mode on or off
source.label: Markdown of the note (source mode)

notices.reloaded: Reloaded the version on disk. Yours is set aside as a draft in the browser.
notices.keptMine: Kept your version. The version on disk went to the trash.
notices.keepAsideFailed: Your version could not be set aside, so nothing was reloaded. Try again, or choose Keep my version.
notices.diskChangedAgain: The file on disk just changed again. Look at the versions again, then choose.

patch.invalid-yaml: The properties have a YAML error. Fix it in source mode (Alt+S) first.
patch.duplicate-key: The properties contain a repeated name. Fix it in source mode (Alt+S) first.
patch.not-mapping: The properties are not in name: value form. Fix them in source mode (Alt+S).
patch.invalid-key: A property name starts with a letter or _ and holds only plain letters, digits, - and _.
patch.unsupported-value: This value cannot be saved from the property bar. Edit it in source mode (Alt+S).
